name: KY-003 hall magnetic field switch
not_buildable: The vendor specifies it for 5 volts only, and its signal could then exceed what the board's inputs are rated for.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a tiny flat black three-legged chip bent out past the board edge. The KY-035 looks the same; without a readable marking they cannot be told apart.

facts.statement: The vendor's technical data gives an operating voltage of 5 V and treats the module as a sensor with 5 V logic level that needs a level shifter on 3.3 V boards.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-003, technical data and Raspberry Pi notes
